title: '500 new vulnerabilities' found in government, says AI minister
excerpt: '500 new vulnerabilities' found in government, says AI minister
content_html:
Organisations around the world are scrambling to fix a critical cyber-security flaw that could affect millions of websites.

Speaking to the BBC before this latest flaw became public, AI Minister Kanishka Narayan reveals that the UK has previously used AI to find hundreds of flaws in government systems.

Read more on cyber-security on our live page.
